text: Implemented the Z8.6 extraction candidate: moved profile opening to shared AsyncNeuroArchiveZarr with Browser facade, added an explicit JVM blocking-gzip runtime with a separately supplied codec execution context, and added byte-identical JVM/Fetch HTTP profile tests sharing exact metadata/HEAD/index/data traces plus cached reread assertions. Extended the oracle to open every canonical Zarr and verify uint8/int16/int32/float32/float64 raw t-z-y-x values, calibrated values, manifest geometry/timing/BIDS identity, and nibabel export fidelity under pinned zarr 3.2.1/nibabel 5.2.1/numpy 1.26.4. Added a hard official BIDS validator 3.0.1 gate and compatibility receipt; exporter now declares current BIDS 1.11.1. Static Python parsing and fixture length/hash checks pass. JVM/JS sbt gates, pinned Python execution, official validator execution, and standalone published-artifact recompilation remain unverified, so this issue stays doing.
